description: This is a utility class 'TestStringGenerator' used for generating test strings of specific byte sizes, primarily for testing purposes within the project.

classes.name: TestStringGenerator
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to generate test strings of specified byte lengths for testing environments.

methods.name: createStringOfBytes
methods.description: Creates a test string consisting of Unicode characters and padding with 'x' to reach the specified byte size.

methods.name: repeat
methods.description: A private helper method that repeats a given string element a specified number of times, returning a Stream of strings.
